subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this sidebar/drawer shell as the permanent iPhone root-navigation contract, replacing the tab bar and Control hub for existing users?
rationale: The patch is technically well-supported, but deciding whether to remove a familiar primary navigation model is a user-experience and product-direction choice that tests cannot resolve.

options.title: Approve the unified sidebar redesign
options.body: Accept the documented drawer interaction, destination hierarchy, and existing-user navigation change as the iOS root-navigation direction.

options.title: Request a narrower transition
options.body: Keep or stage a tab-bar compatibility path until the iOS navigation direction is explicitly narrowed and re-proven.

recommendation.title: Approve the unified sidebar redesign
recommendation.body: Accept the documented drawer interaction, destination hierarchy, and existing-user navigation change as the iOS root-navigation direction.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties steipete to both the related navigation direction and the current iOS implementation sequence.
